title: Title
contextHelp: Type of project and your role (e.g. Short film · Character design).
legacyFeatured: Featured in the old “Featured projects” block
legacyFeaturedHelp: This old block, still present on {pages}, shows the projects ticked here first. “Project” blocks ignore this setting.
dropHere: Drop an image here, or drag one in from the Library
slotTitleHelp: Shown under the image and in the viewer. With no title, only the year is shown.
collectionHelp: The shelf this image is filed under: it appears on that collection's page, and the home page tile counts it.
coverHelp: This image illustrates the “{name}” tile on the home page (“Collection entries” block). If several images are ticked, the first one in the collection is used; if none is ticked, the first image of the collection is used.
altLabel: Image description (for people with low vision, and Google)
altHelp: Describe what can be seen, in one sentence. Shared by every slot that shows this image.
altMissing: Description missing: the title will be read instead.
imageRemoved: Image removed · the slot keeps its place
removeBody: The slot stays on the project, empty (not visible on the site). The image stays in the media library.
deleteBody: Its title and description are lost. The image stays in the media library.
emptyCount: {count, plural, one {# empty (hidden on the site)} other {# empty (hidden on the site)}}
dragInstructions: To move a slot: Space to pick it up, left and right arrows to choose its place, Space to drop it, Escape to cancel.
searchPlaceholder: Search for an image by name…
foundCount: {count, plural, one {# image found} other {# images found}}
planchIntro: Drop images or videos on the strip to add them at the end, or on an empty slot to fill it. Drag by the handle to reorder (keyboard: Space, left and right arrows, Space). Click an image to edit it.
processingNote: images being processed appear on the site as soon as they are ready.
pickerAdd: Add an image from the media library
pickerChoose: Choose the image for this slot
